title: Pong Recharged: A Modern Twist on a Retro Classic
description:
Pong Recharged: A Modern Twist on a Retro Classic

I’ve taken the timeless Pong game and given it a proper glow-up! This project started as an old-school canvas-based game, but I teamed up with some AI magic (shoutout to Grok from xAI) to modernize it. Here’s what’s new and why you’ll love it:

  • Slick ES6 Code: Rewritten with classes, arrow functions, and template literals for a cleaner, more maintainable vibe. Say goodbye to clunky old JavaScript!

  • Retro Meets Modern: Built on HTML5 Canvas with smooth paddle and ball physics, keeping that classic Pong feel while running buttery-smooth in any browser.

  • Styled to Impress: A centered canvas with a dark backdrop and subtle border, making the white paddles and ball pop like never before.

  • Gameplay: Solo against a clever AI paddle, with increasing difficulty across rounds. Can you beat the machine?

How It Works

  • Controls: Use W/S or Up/Down arrows to move your paddle (left side). The AI handles the right.

  • Rounds: Five levels of escalating speed—win or lose, it’s a blast!

Try It Out

Grab the code, drop the sound files in, and open index.html in your browser. Press any key to start—simple as that! Whether you’re a coder looking to tweak it or just here for the nostalgia, this Pong remix delivers.

Thanks

Big thanks to Grok for helping me polish the code and source the sounds. Now, it’s your turn—play it, tweak it, share it. Let me know how you go!
